featured_reviews.name: Vinod Ramanathan
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Haven of Care and Compassion

There are moments in life when we come face-to-face with the extraordinary commitment of others, and my family's experience with Aaji Care's Aarambh Versova is a shining example.  When dementia's shadow fell upon my father, we felt overwhelmed. Yet, this exceptional care center stepped forward as a beacon of hope.

From the first moment we entered, we were enveloped in warmth and understanding. The facility is thoughtfully designed, fostering a serene and secure environment so essential for those living with dementia. The staff, without exception, possess a unique blend of professionalism and heart. They understand that dementia care isn't simply medical, but deeply rooted in respect and personal connection. Their patience knows no bounds, and they find creative ways to engage with each resident, fostering moments of joy.

The activities and programs go beyond mere entertainment, providing both mental stimulation and a sense of purpose.  We've seen how music, gentle exercise, and reminiscence therapy can bring a spark back into my father's eyes, and for that, we are eternally grateful.

We would be remiss if we didn't extend special acknowledgment to Dr. Ruchi and her team of doctors and nursing staff. Their expertise in dementia care is matched only by their compassion. They've guided us through challenging moments, always taking the time to explain and reassure. Their dedication extends far beyond medical management, ensuring my father is treated with the dignity and respect he so richly deserves.

It's rare to find an institution that goes above and beyond what is expected. Aaji Care Aarambh exemplifies this. They are not simply providing care,  they are providing a lifeline for families like ours. The service they offer is an act of profound kindness and deserves our deepest appreciation.

featured_reviews.name: Sujata Shirsekar _ Staff - WhiteOakES
featured_reviews.review_text: Aarambh Aaji care has been a lifesaver for my family in helping me care for my mother. The caregivers have been wonderful with her. They are so caring and compassionate. Everyone in the office as well as all the administrative staff , especially Ajay Pillai, have been top notch and great in communicating with me whenever I  have had needs or concerns regarding her care. My mother transitioned here from the hospital after a hip fracture. She spent four months at Aarambh Aaji Care in Andheri  while waiting for her US visa. Ajay Pillai helped us with every step of the way in making sure my mother was safe and well taken care off until she arrived here  in the US. We are so grateful to have found this place.

featured_reviews.name: Meena Joglekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We brought our parents to Aarambh
about a year and half ago. Both my brother and I are based in the US with family obligations there as well. Although our father’s health is good, due to age (95 years) we felt he would not be able to cope with household duties as well as assisting our mother, who began to need help due to mobility issues (and recently passed away).
We give Aarambh high marks on all the factors that were important to us.
Ajay Pillai and his team run well organized and well-equipped Centers. He personally was extremely helpful in settling our parents down in Versova in the early days.
Dr. Ruchi Raichura has provided excellent professional care along with Nirosha and the nursing staff, especially for our mother in her last days (including making arrangements for her death certificate, funeral, etc) and for our father’s diabetes. They provide regular check-ups, dosage monitoring, support and follow-up in case of medical emergencies.
We also have really appreciated two more persons: the first is Shifa (and Neha), Aarambh psychologist on staff who engages our father in conversations on a variety of topics on a regular basis, providing invaluable emotional support, not to mention an array of activities to keep him mentally active - puzzles, artwork and music. The second is the excellent yoga instructor who comes in 3 times a week, and also a regular physical therapist. Aarambh also has well-planned outings to nearby parks, the beach and temples periodically.
Asma and Milan manage a clean, efficiently run facility, which for our parents included A/C, TV, daily cleaning and chair-lift to the upper level. The staff and attendants are very caring and well-trained. During covid, all procedures regarding vaccinations, and wearing of masks and sanitizers by visitors was observed meticulously.
Baby Singh, the cook, provides a great variety of foods in the meals there and the quality and taste are both very good, to fit the needs of very senior citizens.
Finally, it was very important to have a good communication system in place in order to stay in touch via video on a daily basis. Aarambh provides good wifi and phone access.
We are very happy to have found Aarambh, and highly recommend it.
Meena Joglekar & Uday Watwe

I was born in Mumbai and now live in the U.K. and my father has lived here his whole life… in May he was diagnosed with a rare and aggressive cancer and we jointly decided he needed to shift to a elder care home… I came in May and visited many places…. None of them hit the mark…. Some were too clinical and hospital like, some were understaffed and looked really depressing, some were too far out of Mumbai to be practical and then finally I visited Olive in Vashi.
Immediately upon meeting the centre manager Mr Ashher and the psychologist Subhashree, I knew I’d found the right place… their warmth and enthusiasm was evident within minutes of my arrival… i had a look around and very quickly i realised my prayers had been answered…. We were racing against the clock… my father was given 2 months prognosis and he was unable to move around so I had to visit the homes by myself…. We agreed when I found the right place he would come and take the final call…. I went home and told him about the home, and we should take a look…. He said no need, I can make out by the way you speak about the place that it will be suitable…. And from there he instructed me to pack his bag…
I stayed for about 10’days while he settled in and I was dreading my pending return to the U.K. as I have a family and a business to run.
Upon returning I was in touch daily, the home sent me pictures daily, as my father weakened and was unable to use his phone, they facilitated all the calls from their personal phone…. The two personal caretakers, Raj and Tushar were pivotal in all this happening… anytime I needed something, any special request to ensure his comfort, a quick WhatsApp and it was as good as done… the doctors were also fantastic…. Extremely thorough, with daily reports…. Every decision they made would be authorised by me first…. And no stones were left unturned…. In the final days his level of treatment and care was increased and they managed the situation also…. No need to go to a hospital and disrupt my father as by now shifting him would be very stressful…. Finally my father found his peace and this is when the Olive family rose up and supported me in my darkest hour…. Being from abroad I had no idea what to do…. And on top of processing the emotions of huge loss, at this point even remembering my name and date of birth would have been tricky…. They organised everything from tedious paperwork right down to the crematorium…. Even now I’m no longer a client I just know if I need any help, a quick WhatsApp and it will be done….
Thank you team Olive… you looked after my father like he was part of the family…. You have helped me through what I can only describe as one of the toughest moments in my life…. You’re a credit to your industry and each and every one of you have shown nothing but empathy and pure class.
May you always be blessed and may you always continue to bless other families in their moment of need.
Om Shanti

At My Care, we understand the importance of elderly care and strive to deliver exceptional services, including assisted living, dementia care, and Alzheimer's care. Our team of dedicated caregivers and medical professionals work tirelessly to ensure that our residents receive the best possible care, whether it's post hospital care or simply companionship. We also offer elderly caregiver for home services, providing families with peace of mind knowing that their loved ones are in good hands. As one of the leading retirement homes in Mumbai, we pride ourselves on our commitment to senior care and senior living, providing a range of amenities and activities tailored to the needs and interests of our residents. featured_reviews.name: AdityaRao Abnave
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a very good experience with My Care Elderly Wellness Centre Andheri Branch. The staff is caring and patient and they look after elders with a lot of attention. My father was comfortable there and that gave our family a lot of peace of mind. Thank you to the entire team.

featured_reviews.name: Sweety Akshay Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a very good experience with My Care Elderly Wellness Centre Andheri Branch. The staff is caring, the environment is comfortable, and the support given to senior citizens is really good. If anyone is searching for a reliable elderly wellness centre in Andheri or trusted elder care in Mumbai - My Care is a very good option.

featured_reviews.name: Aaliya Ansari
featured_reviews.review_text: My mother stayed at My Care Elderly Wellness Centre for some time, and we were genuinely happy with the care given to her. The team was supportive, the food was suitable for elders and everything was managed properly. It felt reassuring to know she was in safe hands.

featured_reviews.name: Kunal Fulwariya
featured_reviews.review_text: We had kept my grandfather at My Care Elderly Wellness Centre, and what I appreciated most was not just the care but also the regular updates they share on the WhatsApp group throughout the day. From morning hand and leg massage, breakfast, fruits, lunch and dinner to simple exercises and evening games for the elders, everything is updated properly. These small updates gives a lot of peace of mind to family members. Hats off to the entire team of My Care Elderly Wellness Centre.

featured_reviews.name: Harshid Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: They genuinely take good care of elders with patience and responsibility. The food, daily routine and overall attention are very well managed. Highly recommended for anyone looking for an elderly care centre in Andheri or a safe senior living care option in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Aliya Sayyed
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a great experience with My Care Elderly Wellness Centre. After my mother  surgery, their team provided professional and compassionate care Specially Jyoti Nurse. Highly recommended

featured_reviews.name: Mukesh sangare
featured_reviews.review_text: Our family had 2 travel 2 Dehradun 4 a wedding 4 almost 20 days, but it was not possible 4 my grandmother to travel that far. We felt very guilty leaving her behind n we were worried she would feel lonely. While searching online 4 a short stay elderly care centre in Andheri we found My Care Elderly Wellness Centre. Honestly, it was a huge relief. My grandmother was happy, comfortable and cared for during her stay. Special thanks to Jyoti Nikam Nurse and the entire team for making her feel at home.

featured_reviews.name: Ganesh Thombre
featured_reviews.review_text:
My papa has dementia and it was very difficult to handle him at home. I found My Care Elderly Wellness Centre Andheri on Instagram and admitted him here.

After joining this dementia care centre in Andheri there is a lot of improvement in him and many symptoms have reduced. Special thanks to Jyoti Madam and her team for taking such good care of my papa.

featured_reviews.name: Arvind Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: BHN CarePlus+ provides exceptional old age care at home Mumbai families can truly rely on. Their team is professional, deeply compassionate, and attentive to every medical and personal detail. It has brought our family immense peace of mind knowing our loved ones are in such capable hands. Highly recommended for premium home health services!

featured_reviews.name: Vijayakumar R
featured_reviews.review_text: We were looking for the best nursing care at home mumbai after my father’s surgery, and BHN CarePlus+ exceeded our expectations. The nursing staff is highly professional, punctual, and handled all clinical requirements with great expertise. It made the recovery process so much easier for our family.

featured_reviews.name: Prachi D
featured_reviews.review_text: I was told that an 'experienced' male care giver will be available at 8am at the hospital location that i had provided on the previous day. Care giver spoke to me,  verified the address the previous day. On his first day, he doesn't arrive on time. 8.15, 8.30 no matter how many times we try to reach him or the bhn mainline no one picks up. 8.45 he finally calls.  No apologies. He says he's near and how exactly is he to reach the location. You cannot be asking these questions 45 mins after your time of arrival. Nope. I have far sensible care givers coming from other bureaus.

featured_reviews.name: Sia Chawla
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been so fortunate to have chosen BHN as they have the most effecient and polite staff . Ms Sushma over there provided me with a caretaker  within no time . Their quick and timely help was much needed by me for my Dad . The caretaker named Mohan , sent by them was also a professional one and extremely helpful . A big thanks to BHN for being so nice and for the instant support they gave. For people who need good staff also on urgent basis BHN is highly recomended .

featured_reviews.name: Mayank Bharucha
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a fantastic experience with BHN Health Care. The staff was professional, compassionate, and genuinely cared about my well-being. From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed and supported. The medical team was knowledgeable and took the time to explain everything clearly, making sure I felt comfortable and informed throughout my visit. The facility was clean and well-organized, which added to the overall sense of trust and safety. Highly recommend BHN Health Care to anyone looking for quality and compassionate health services!

featured_reviews.name: Sudha R
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had approached BHN agency for male caretaker requirement for my old father (aged 90 years old). They were very prompt in their response and sent the person as scheduled. If the person was unable to come for any reason, the BHN agency sent replacement also promptly. My father was always in safe care with their people. All the caretakers sent by BHN were polite, on time, well trained and very helpful to my father, who was having many age-related issues. The caretakers dealt with all the needs professionally and properly. Thank you BHN for the services you have provided.
BHN is doing an important service to people and I highly recommend them.

featured_reviews.name: Rachita Dhutia
featured_reviews.review_text: The full-time carer from BHN Home took very good care of my elderly father-in-law who was bedridden for the last 1.5 years. He was well trained to carry out all the responsibilities from hygiene care to providing food, medicines and keeping track of basic vitals such as blood sugar and pressure. He was alert at all times and above all had a good temperament as he managed an elderly patient with utmost care, compassion and patience. I would highly recommend the agency.

featured_reviews.name: Shaheda Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: “Very happy with BHN Care. The team is professional, caring, and supportive. They took excellent care of my grandfather with compassion and attention. Truly one of the best home healthcare services – highly recommended!”
